Question Paper  
Exam Date & Time: 21-Jun-2024 (09:30 AM - 12:30 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  SECOND SEMESTER B.TECH. DEGREE EXAMINATIONS - JUNE 2024  
  SUBJECT: CHM 1071-CHM/CHM 1071-B/CHM 1051-B - ENGINEERING CHEMISTRY  
  ENGINEERING CHEMISTRY [CHM 1071-CHM]  
Marks: 50                                                                                                       Duration: 180 mins.  
  
  A  
Answer all the questions.  
  
1A)                Write the construction of the following.                                                               (2)  
  a) Lithium ion battery  
  i)           b) Galvanic cell  
  
  ii)          Write a note on the Electroless plating of copper with necessary reactions.                            (2)  
1B)                A glass electrode dipped in a solution of pH=4 offered an EMF of 0.2044 V with SCE at 298 K.           (2)  
  Dipped in a solution of unknown pH, at the same temperature in contact with SCE recorded an  
  i)           EMF of 0.1452 V. Calculate the pH of the solution, if ESCE = 0.2412 V.  
  
  ii)          Explain the role of salt bridge in elimination of liquid junction potential.                           (2)  
1C)                Differentiate between the following.                                                                   (2)  
  i) Hard and decorative chromium plating  
  ii) Alkaline and proton exchange membrane fuel cell.  
2A)                i) Explain the variation of potentiometric titration of a weak acid with a strong base.          (4)  
  ii) A chemist has a sample of Adenine with a percentage transmission of light is 80. The molar  
  absorption coefficient and path length for the medium are 0.0245 M-1 cm-1 and 2 cm respectively.  
  Calculate the concentration of the adenine sample.  
2B)                Explain the following process in softening of water:                                                   (4)  
  i) Phosphate Conditioning  
  ii) Calgon Conditioning  
2C)                Differentiate the following:                                                                           (2)  
  i) Temporary and permanent hardness of water  
  ii) Sludge and scale in water boilers  
3A)                i) Write any two differences between the following.                                                    (4)  
  a) Galvanizing and Tinning  
  b) EMF and Galvanic series  
  ii) Discuss the sacrificial anode method of corrosion control.  
3B)                Identify and explain the form of corrosion:                                                            (4)  
  i) Steel pipeline connected to copper plumbing  
  ii) Depletion of chromium in the grain boundary regions.  
3C)                Explain electrochemical theory of corrosion.                                                           (2)  
4A)                i)Write the distinguishing features of addition and condensation polymerization reactions.             (4)  
  ii) Differentiate between thermotropic an lyotropic liquid crystals.  
4B)                With a schematic diagram, explain the process of physical vapor deposition. Differentiate (Any two     (4)  
  points) between PVD and CVD.  
4C)                A polymer has the following composition: 100 molecules of molecular mass 1000 g/mol, 200               (2)  
  
  Page 1 of 2

molecules of molecular mass 2000 g/mol and 500 molecules of molecular mass 5000 g/mol.  
  Calculate the number average and weight average molecular weight of the polymer.  
5A)   i) For the cell, Zn | Zn 2+ (0.1) || Cu2+ (0.25) | Cu, write the cell reactions. If the standard EMF of the   (4)  
  cell is 1.1 V at 298 K, calculate the EMF and the change in free energy for the cell at 298 K.  
  ii)Give reason - Standard electrode potential of Zn electrode is negative whereas, the standard  
  electrode potential of Cu electrode is positive.  
5B)   i) Explain the preparation of nanomaterials by ball milling method.                                           (4)  
  ii) Explain how the structure of the polymer affects the tensile strength.  
5C)   Explain the role of inhibitors in corrosion protection.                                                       (2)  
  
  
  -----End-----
